sys_hub_action_type_definition.description: Looks up either a consumer or a contact by phone number. When found, retrieves customer profile details, financial accounts (checking, savings, credit cards, loans), current open cases, the business account they are calling from (if a contact), and all customer-visible open tasks on those cases.
